lines.name: Line 4
lines.colourNote: Line 4's colour was changed from Orange to Yellow in 2025 (wiki-line4). CMRL has not published an official hex value; #F2B705 is an approximation.
lines.status: Partially open. Lighthouse–Vadapalani (Kodambakkam Power House section and the underground core) is under construction.

lines.name: Line 2
lines.status: Open. Interchange with Line 4 at Vadapalani.

lines.name: Line 5
lines.status: Under construction. Shares the Arcot Road double-decker with Line 4 (upper deck) between Alapakkam and Alwarthirunagar.

fares.note: Intermediate fares (Rs 20–30) were reported by distance band; CMRL is to publish the full chart after inauguration.
